title: Chapter 216 People Of Xiao Clan?
content:
Chapter 216 People Of Xiao Clan?

"Then let these two guys hang out here?"

After a moment of silence, one of the phantoms slowly said in a hoarse voice: "Old rule, knock it out first and then lock it up."

Then, another phantom trembled and disappeared in an instant.

At this time, Lu Xue was still walking leisurely on the mountain road.

"There is nothing, can this be called the ancestral land?"

While walking, Lu Xue couldn't help but complain a few times.

bite!

At this moment, a crisp metal collision sound suddenly sounded from the back of Lu Xue's head.

Lu Xue was slightly stunned and turned to look in surprise.

I saw a middle-aged man with long hair hanging down was standing behind him, still maintaining a posture of slashing himself with his hands.

At this moment, a disbelief expression was hanging on the face of the long-haired man.

"you!"

The long-haired man did not expect that with his own blow, he would not cause any harm to this woman who was only in the Immortal King Realm.

Lu Xue also quickly discovered something was wrong, so she quickly retreated, staring at the long-haired man in front of her with an unkind look.

"Who are you? Why did you attack me?"

Hearing this, the long-haired man looked cold, but he did not answer.

A bang!

The long-haired man rushed towards Lu Xue, clasped his fists and was about to hit Lu Xue's face.

"Little Master!"

Suddenly, Ao Qing rushed out of Lu Xue's arm.

Immediately afterwards, a light golden light enveloped Lu Xue's entire body.

But Lu Xue's face changed, "Xiaoqing, retreat quickly!"

Because Lu Xue suddenly realized that the long-haired man in front of him was actually a late-stage ninth-level Immortal Emperor Realm. If Ao Qing's body helped him block it, he would probably be gone.

Lu Xue grabbed Ao Qing's tail and pulled Ao Qing directly behind her.

The next moment.

boom!

The powerful punch hit Lu Xue's face.

In just a moment, Lu Xue was knocked away and smashed into the rocks.

"What are you doing?"

At this time, a figure appeared beside the long-haired man, and said with dissatisfaction.

Hearing the questioning, the long-haired man looked a little solemn.

"This woman is not simple."

"not simple?"

"Ahem!"

At this time, a cough suddenly came from the pile of rocks.

The two of them suddenly looked there.

I saw Lu Xue crawling out of the rocks. Although she looked a little embarrassed, she was not hurt at all.

"This is impossible!"

The long-haired man's heart was stormy.

The aura of this woman's fairy king is not fake at all.

Could it be that I am a fake immortal emperor?

At this time, the man next to the long-haired man discovered the clue.

"No, look."

The long-haired man was slightly stunned, then looked at it intently and suddenly found a thin halo covering Lu Xue's whole body.

Isolated everything, including the attack of the man who just had a long hair.

"It's a treasure!"

The two of them immediately understood.

No wonder an immortal king dares to trek here, it seems that he is prepared.

At this time, Lu Xue was completely angry.

"You guys are too much!"

Buzz —

A sword sounded.

A long sword suddenly appeared in Lu Xue's hand, and the sword light flowed and its sharpness was revealed.

Xuanyuan Sword!

At this moment, Xuanyuan Sword was also trembling slightly, emitting its anger.

Lu Xue held the Xuanyuan Sword tightly and looked at the two men with long hair, looking cold.

"My little master, give me some treasures and teach them a lesson!"

Ao Qing also stood up and glared at the two people in the distance.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

He threw it directly to Ao Qing with a spear and a shield.

In an instant, Ao Qing turned into a human form, holding a spear in his right hand and a shield in his left hand, and his momentum suddenly came up.

At this time, Ao Qing's eyes were already shining with stars.

"This is so handsome!"

"My master, why didn't you take this good thing out earlier if you have this good thing?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue gave Ao Qing a white look and said angrily: "Have you taken it out and let you go out to pretend? What will I pretend after you finish it?"

Ao Qing:...

At this time, Lu Xue said again: "Remember to return it to me after using it."

Ao Qing: "Ah?"

In the distance, the two looked at Lu Xue and Ao Qing, and a deep look of solemnity was revealed.

A sword, plus a spear and a shield.

The two of them had good eyesight and could see at a glance that these three things were absolutely extraordinary.

"Who are you two and why are you here?"

At this time, the man next to the long-haired man asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue sneered.

"What, I just remember to ask now?"

"What have you done before?"

"Xiaoqing, beat them up!"

"Yes, little master!"

With a whoosh, one man and one dragon went straight towards the two of them.

The terrifying explosion suddenly sounded from the mountain, deafening.

I don't know how long it took.

"Stop it all!!"

An angry shout suddenly rang out.

The two men with long hair quickly retreated and retreated far away.

Lu Xue and Ao Qing were slightly stunned and frowned.

I saw that a woman in orange stood at a mountain at some point and looked at them coldly.

At this time, the long-haired men looked a little ugly.

Both of them are in the late stage of the Ninth Level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, but facing Lu Xue and Ao Qing, who are immortal kings, not only do they not get a little advantage, but they are also beaten backwards and have to keep dodging.

Because Lu Xue and Ao Qing’s treasures are really amazing.

His own attack hit the opponent without any harm.

But the two of them dared not take the other party's attack, because it was too terrifying.

It is almost even more terrifying than the attack of a peak powerful man in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

What kind of powerful man's magic weapon is so terrifying?

Fortunately, Lu Xue and Ao Qing's cultivation level are still very low. Although they can't beat it, they can still avoid it.

When they saw the woman in orange, they were relieved.

"Mr. Yin."

The two bowed to the woman in orange.

Seeing this, Lu Xue frowned even deeper.

It's actually a group.

At this time, the woman in orange looked at Lu Xue with a calm expression.

"You are not from the Xiao clan, why can you enter here?"

When Lu Xue heard the woman in orange ask questions, he snorted: "Who are you? Why should I tell you?"

On the side, Ao Qing held the spear in his hand tightly and was ready at any time.

However, the woman in orange had no anger on her face.

Looking at Lu Xue for a long time, the woman in orange slowly said, "My name is Xiao Yin, a member of the Xiao clan. This is the ancestral land of my Xiao clan."

As soon as these words came out, Lu Xue and Ao Qing were stunned.

Members of the Xiao clan? !

"You, are you really a member of the Xiao clan?"

Lu Xue said in confusion.

I came in by myself and came to find the Xiao people, and then I solved the cause of the problem here.

At this time, the woman in front of her turned out to be a member of the Xiao tribe.

Hearing this, the woman in orange nodded slightly, waved her sleeves, and a token flew into Lu Xue's hands.

Looking at the token with the word Xiao in his hand, Lu Xue also recognized that this was the unique identity token of the Xiao clan, which could not deceive people.
